notes: INCOMPLETE: the shared web search limit (200 per turn) ran out after 8 searches, and curl to the wiki was blocked, so only part of the list could be checked. Verified from search snippets (wiki.gg ferry table, SCS blog, Iceland DLC news): Dover-Calais, Eurotunnel, Harwich-Rotterdam, Hull-Esbjerg, Rostock-Gedser, Hirtshals to Bergen/Stavanger/Kristiansand, Plymouth-Santander, Messina-Villa San Giovanni, Cagliari-Palermo, Ancona-Split, Ancona-Durrës, Bari-Durrës, and the Iceland routes. The Iceland DLC was released on 10 Nov 2026 and adds Hirtshals/Ålesund/Rotterdam to Iceland. Most Scandinavia and Baltic routes are from memory (medium or low confidence). Greece DLC routes are poorly verified: SCS confirms ferries to Lesbos, Chios, Kefalonia, Crete (Souda/Chania) and Rhodes, plus a Trieste ferry to Greece, but the exact port pairs and in-game spellings are unknown. In-game spellings of Greek ports such as Piraeus/Patra/Heraklion are guesses. No ferry found for Nordic Horizons or for Turkey/Black Sea (except the Danube ferry at Brăila). Bergen-Santander and Esbjerg-Bilbao come from a mod changelog and are probably not vanilla. Recommended next step: a follow-up run with search budget to check the trucksimulator.wiki.gg page Ferry/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2 table one DLC at a time.
